AM General plans an XTEND aerial-robot integration display

The announcement combines an unmanned ground vehicle with a mobile drone-launch system.

AM General ↗9 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 2

An upcoming display

AM General announced an XTEND NEST-equipped UGV for AUSA in Washington, D.C., on October 12–14. This is a pre-show announcement, not a completed field evaluation.

The mobile platform’s role

NEST supports aerial-robot deployment from fixed or moving platforms. The company says carrying it on a UGV can let operators remain farther from hazardous locations.

Display versus delivery

The release also illustrates JLTV A2 and a modernized HUMVEE. It provides neither independent evaluation results nor customer delivery details for the UGV–XTEND combination.
